components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:4.15rem; padding:0 var(--page-pad, clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem)); color:var(--ink, #11110f); background:rgba(242,240,233,.96); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(17,17,15,.24)); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); font-family:Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-mark { font-family:'Archivo Display', sans-serif; font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .ds-nav div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:clamp(.8rem, 2.4vw, 2.1rem); } .ds-nav a, .ds-nav button { padding:.4rem 0; border:0; color:inherit; background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100% / 0 1px no-repeat transparent; font:760 .72rem/1.6 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-size 180ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:hover, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { background-size:100% 1px; outline:none; }

components.name: Game Start
components.description: Full-width acid action bar that starts or restarts photon calibration.
components.css: .ds-game-start { width:100%; min-height:3.6rem; border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(245,244,238,.25); color:var(--dark, #0b0c0d); background:var(--acid, #d8ff38); font:820 .72rem/1.6 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-game-start:hover, .ds-game-start:focus-visible { color:var(--light, #f5f4ee); background:#33451a; outline:3px solid #3566ff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-game-start:active { filter:brightness(.9); } .ds-game-start:disabled { color:#8f918c; background:#272a2c; cursor:wait; }

components.name: Playlist Status Toggle
components.description: Persistent floating playlist control with a live optical signal.
components.css: .ds-status { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.62rem; padding:.72rem .9rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #11110f); border-radius:999px; color:var(--paper, #f2f0e9); background:var(--ink, #11110f); box-shadow:0 .8rem 2.4rem rgba(17,17,15,.2); font:780 .68rem/1.6 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-status i { width:.45rem; height:.45rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--acid, #d8ff38); box-shadow:0 0 .7rem rgba(216,255,56,.7); } .ds-status:hover, .ds-status:focus-visible { color:var(--ink, #11110f); background:var(--acid, #d8ff38); box-shadow:0 1rem 3rem rgba(17,17,15,.3); outline:3px solid #3566ff; outline-offset:3px; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-status:hover i, .ds-status:focus-visible i { background:var(--ink, #11110f); } .ds-status:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-project { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(15rem,1fr) minmax(12rem,.7fr) minmax(16rem,1fr); gap:2rem; padding:1.65rem 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(245,244,238,.52); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(245,244,238,.25); color:var(--light, #f5f4ee); background:var(--dark, #0b0c0d); font-family:Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition:color 220ms ease, background 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-project h3, .ds-project p, .ds-project span { margin:0; } .ds-project h3 { font:600 1.35rem/1.35 'Portfolio Serif', serif; } .ds-project p { color:#aeb0aa; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:780; } .ds-project span { color:#d1d2cd; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.7; } .ds-project:hover, .ds-project:focus-within { color:var(--dark, #0b0c0d); background:var(--acid, #d8ff38); transform:translateX(.4rem); } .ds-project:hover p, .ds-project:hover span, .ds-project:focus-within p, .ds-project:focus-within span { color:var(--dark, #0b0c0d); }

components.name: Resource Link
components.description: Two-column catalogue link separated by thin rules and inverted on interaction.
components.css: .ds-resource { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:2rem; padding:1rem 0; border-top:1px solid var(--ink, #11110f); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(17,17,15,.24)); color:var(--ink, #11110f); background:transparent; text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-resource span { font:600 1.02rem/1.4 'Portfolio Serif', serif; } .ds-resource small { color:var(--quiet, #65645d); font:400 .72rem/1.6 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-resource:hover, .ds-resource:focus-visible { color:var(--paper, #f2f0e9); background:var(--ink, #11110f); outline:3px solid #3566ff; outline-offset:3px; transform:translateX(.35rem); } .ds-resource:hover small, .ds-resource:focus-visible small { color:#c8c6bf; } .ds-resource:active { transform:translateX(.15rem); }

components.css: .ds-dialog { position:relative; width:min(100%,470px); padding:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,2.5rem); color:var(--light, #f5f4ee); background:var(--dark, #0b0c0d); box-shadow:0 2rem 6rem rgba(0,0,0,.4); font-family:Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-close { position:absolute; top:1.2rem; right:1.2rem; display:grid; min-width:2.75rem; min-height:2.75rem; place-items:center; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #747771; color:#b7b9b3; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-dialog-label { margin:0 0 2.5rem; color:var(--acid, #d8ff38); font-size:.58rem; font-weight:820; letter-spacing:.15em; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin:0; font:600 2.15rem/1.2 'Portfolio Serif', serif; } .ds-dialog p:not(.ds-dialog-label) { max-width:25rem; color:#b7b9b3; font-size:.86rem; line-height:1.8; } .ds-dialog a { color:var(--acid, #d8ff38); font-size:.76rem; text-underline-offset:.26em; } .ds-dialog-close:hover, .ds-dialog-close:focus-visible, .ds-dialog a:hover, .ds-dialog a:focus-visible { color:var(--acid, #d8ff38); outline:3px solid #3566ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Photo Tile
components.description: Square-edged editorial crop with a restrained caption and no generic overlay chrome.
components.css: .ds-photo { width:min(100%,28rem); margin:0; color:var(--ink-soft, #393833); font-family:Aptos, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-photo div { width:100%; aspect-ratio:4 / 5; background:#d3d0c6; box-shadow:none; transition:clip-path 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-photo figcaption { margin-top:.65rem; font-size:.66rem; line-height:1.55; } .ds-photo:focus-within div { outline:3px solid #3566ff; outline-offset:4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-photo div { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Photon Target
components.description: Circular light target whose glow reads as emission, not card elevation.
components.css: .ds-photon { position:relative; width:3.15rem; aspect-ratio:1; padding:0; border:1px solid rgba(235,255,157,.92); border-radius:50%; background:rgba(216,255,56,.08); box-shadow:0 0 1.8rem rgba(216,255,56,.45); cursor:crosshair; transition:box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-photon::after { position:absolute; inset:-34%; border:1px solid rgba(216,255,56,.22); border-radius:50%; content:''; } .ds-photon span { position:absolute; inset:39%; border-radius:50%; background:#f4ffca; box-shadow:0 0 1rem .4rem rgba(216,255,56,.72); } .ds-photon:hover, .ds-photon:focus-visible { border-color:#fff; outline:2px solid var(--acid, #d8ff38); outline-offset:5px; box-shadow:0 0 2.5rem rgba(216,255,56,.7); } .ds-photon:active { transform:scale(1.35); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-photon { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a photography exhibition catalogue left open on a warm light table. Oversized black type acts as architecture, while real photographs overlap, rotate, and change scale like selected prints being sequenced by hand. The experience is expressive but not autobiographical: the work identifies the maker before explanatory copy does.

Most of the exhibition stays flat, bright, and editorial. Dark optical chambers interrupt that paper world for projects, the photon game, and the playlist; acid lime appears only where a live signal, playable action, or current state needs attention. Motion reinforces the handling of prints and light rather than becoming decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds, hard black rules, and broad editorial whitespace.
Monumental Archivo grotesque paired with a display Chinese serif and a quiet system sans.
Real photography in deliberately uneven crops, scales, offsets, and contact-sheet rhythms.
Dark, square-edged optical chambers punctuated by rare acid-lime signals.
Responsive recomposition that preserves the exhibition, game, and playlist on touch screens.

rules.name: The One Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Optical Acid is the only recurring chromatic interaction signal; do not introduce competing neon accents.

rules.name: The Photograph Owns Its Color Rule
rules.body: Seasonal fields may echo the photographs, but their job is to frame the work, never to recolor or overpower it.

rules.name: The Type Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Display words may touch edges, overlap photographs, and wrap into sculptural blocks; body copy must remain calm, conventionally aligned, and comfortably spaced.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo for monumental display, Portfolio Serif for editorial emphasis, and the system sans for utility. Do not substitute extra typefaces for local variation.

rules.name: The Sequence Before Symmetry Rule
rules.body: Preserve the hierarchy of lead, support, portrait, and panorama images; do not normalize the journals into equal cards or a uniform masonry feed.

rules.name: The Flat Exhibition Rule
rules.body: Never add resting shadows to lists, content sections, captions, or ordinary photo tiles. A shadow must communicate a loose print, floating control, modal layer, or emitted light.

rules.name: The Geometry Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Squares hold content, circles represent light, and the pill represents persistent status. Do not round generic containers.

dos: **Do** lead with photographs and exhibition-scale type; explanatory copy supports the sequence rather than introducing the author first.
**Do** preserve the paper/ink base, rare Optical Acid signal, and seasonal mats tied to specific journals.
**Do** keep photo replacements truthful, dimensioned, meaningfully described, and cropped to the role they occupy.
**Do** test the 900px and 640px recompositions, 320px minimum width, keyboard navigation, dialog focus return, game keyboard input, and reduced-motion mode after visual changes.
**Do** update both `DESIGN.md` and `.impeccable/design.json` when durable tokens, components, breakpoints, motion, or visual rules change.
donts: **Don't** turn photography journals, project rows, or resource links into rounded cards.
**Don't** normalize the asymmetric photo sequences into equal tiles or replace real work with decorative stock imagery.
**Don't** introduce gradients, extra neon colors, or shadows outside the documented optical and floating-object roles.
**Don't** shrink mobile display type into a conventional heading scale or hide core navigation, the photon game, or playlist behavior.
**Don't** remove visible keyboard focus, touch targets, alternative text, intrinsic image dimensions, or reduced-motion fallbacks.
